description: Runs one flow now and returns whatever its last operation produced. The side effects are whatever the flow does, which can mean writing items, sending mail or calling external services, so treat it as destructive unless the flow is known to be read-only. Flows with a manual trigger accept this reliably; others may refuse it or ignore the payload. data becomes the trigger payload and must match what the flow expects. Read the flow with get_flow before running it.

data.description: Data to pass to the flow

name: trigger_flow
